mentions.name: Kviklet
mentions.description: Self-hosted database access management tool that provides code-review-style approval workflows for SQL statements before they run in production. Includes a Postgres proxy and a MySQL wire proxy so developers can keep using psql or DataGrip while every statement is logged, with SSO support and no password sharing.
mentions.problem: Developers need to run SQL statements against production databases without a review process, which previously required insecure password sharing.
mentions.audience: Development teams needing controlled, reviewed access to production databases.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Self hosted database access management, think Code Reviews for SQL Statements for when your devs need to go to prod:
https://github.com/kviklet/kviklet

Recently cleaned up my postgres proxy and built a MySQL wire proxy so that you can use psql/datagrip as a dev but every statement is still logged.
With SSO and no password sharing ofc!
mentions.author: jascha_eng
